newsitem.title: HONG KONG: It may rain on Hong Kong's party.
newsitem.headline: It may rain on Hong Kong's party.

text.p: Hong Kong residents looking forward to their biggest-ever party next week should take an umbrella -- and that's official.
In its first forecast on Thursday of conditions for June 30, the date the sun sets on the British Empire, Hong Kong's Royal Observatory said there was a possibility of showers.
"Our forecast is for sunny periods but with the possibility of showers," a Royal Observatory spokesman said.
The temperature was forecast to reach a muggy 28 to 32 degrees Celsius (82.4 to 89.6 Fahrenheit) with moderate winds likely.
Officials in charge of the handover are prepared.
They have 10,000 umbrellas on hand for the 4,000 invited guests.
